liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Dr. Rock** (1 other source): Dr. Rock is flagged in the notes as running into I'll Be Your Johnny on the Spot, then You Fucked Up [1]

## The recordings

- **ween2005-10-30.flac16** (recommended): source not stated; 20 songs; 165 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [1]. Said about its sound: Track splitting is odd near the end, with two fewer splits than expected, but all the audio is present [1]
- **ween2005-10-30.mk4v.flac16**: source not stated; 20 songs; 83 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [2]. Said about its sound: Recording is good, though the vocals sit forward in the mix [8]
- **ween2005-10-30.oktava**: source not stated; 20 songs; 83 min [3]
- **ween2005-10-30.mk4v.flac24**: source not stated; 20 songs; 83 min [4]

## Around the show

- Reviewer found the set rather short, leaving them wanting more [8]
- Recorded at the Star Nursery Field at Sam Boyd Stadium, UNLV [3]
- Reviewer ranks this among the best sets of the Vegoose festival [8]

## Tapers and lineage

- **ween2005-10-30.flac16**: taped by Ian Stone; transferred by Ian Stone; source: Schoeps mk4v(FOB 30' DFC)>kc5>cmc6>sound devices 722 @ 24/48 [1]. Also: Uploader did not tape it; got it from a torrent and does not know the taper [1]
- **ween2005-10-30.mk4v.flac16**: taped by sleepypedro (pwking); transferred by sleepypedro (pwking); source: schoeps mk4v > vms02ib > edirol r4 (24/96) [2]
- **ween2005-10-30.oktava**: taped by c dipietro; transferred by c dipietro; source: Oktava MC012 (hypercard) fob 60' center > Graham Patten Dmic20 with Todd mod> maudio c02> jb3 @ 48k [3]. Also: Recorded and transferred by c dipietro, an archive.org user [3]
- **ween2005-10-30.mk4v.flac24**: taped by sleepypedro (pwking); transferred by sleepypedro (pwking); source: schoeps mk4v > vms02ib > edirol r4 (24/96) [4]
